"""Publish actual V163 readiness and a historical original-live snapshot."""
import json
import time
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V163-harmonic-phase-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json');guard(post)
smoke=read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json');assert smoke['counts']==smoke['updates']=={'anchor-control':10,'harmonic-phase':10}
assert smoke['exact_V162_control_trace_rows']==10
state=torch.load(smoke['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True);finite=0
for arm,expected in [('anchor-control',46),('harmonic-phase',47)]:
    assert state['arms'][arm]['parameter_tensors']==expected
    assert len(state['models'][arm])==len(state['emas'][arm])==len(state['optimizers'][arm]['state'])==expected
    assert all(float(s['step'])==10 for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for key in ['models','emas'] for v in state[key][arm].values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values() for v in s.values());finite+=expected
assert finite==93 and all(min(v.values())>0 for v in smoke['parameter_maximum_gradients'].values())
assert state['models']['harmonic-phase']['phase_in.weight'].count_nonzero()>0
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json');assert len(parity['rows'])==28 and parity['component_forward_evaluations']==56
checks=parity['CUDA_anchor_loss_checks'];assert len(checks)==10 and all(v['neural_forwards']==0 and v['leaf_backwards']==1 for v in checks)
snapshot=root/'readiness-training-prefix-v1.jsonl';assert not snapshot.exists()
with (root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').open() as stream:lines=[next(stream) for _ in range(40)]
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in lines];baseline=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace']
for i,row in enumerate(rows):
    old=baseline[i];assert row['step']==old['step'] and row['batch']==old['batch'] and row['domain']==old['domain']
    assert row['flat_target_mask']==old['flat_target_mask']
    expected=old['arms']['flat-anchor'];assert {k:row['arms']['anchor-control'][k] for k in expected}==expected
snapshot.write_text(''.join(lines))
status=read(root/'status-v1.json');poststatus=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert status['status']=='running-declared-phase' and status['phase']=='train'
assert poststatus['status']=='waiting-for-original-training-owner'
owners=[]
for role,owner in [('training-controller',status['owner']),('train-worker',status['child']),('review-controller',poststatus['owner'])]:
    p=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);assert abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])<.01 and p.status() not in ['dead','zombie']
    owners.append({'role':role,**owner,'argv':p.cmdline(),'status':p.status()})
live_snapshot=root/'prepared-live-snapshot-v1.json';assert not live_snapshot.exists()
save(live_snapshot,{'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'training':status,'postprocess':poststatus,
    'progress':read(root/'train-progress-v1.json'),'observed_live_owners':owners,
    'scope':'Historical actual live snapshot,not final quality/counts. Original workers continue once.'})
ready=root/'readiness-audit-v1.json';assert not ready.exists()
save(ready,{'status':'pass-actual-restored-smoke-exact-control-prefix-and-CUDA-loss-checks',
    'smoke':ref(root/'smoke-result-v1.json'),'finite_Adam_states_at10':93,
    'all93_parameter_tensors_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients':True,'exact_V162_control_prefix_rows':40,
    'exact_inherited_independently_audited_training_masks':40,'training_prefix':ref(snapshot),
    'inherited_mask_audit':ref(Path(plan['previous'])/'training-mask-audit-v1.json'),
    'smoke_peak_CUDA_bytes':smoke['CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes'],'independent_CUDA_mask_loss_gradient_checks':10,
    'maximum_CUDA_loss_adjoint_difference':max(v['maximum_adjoint_difference'] for v in checks),
    'new_neural_forwards':0,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
failure=repo/'docs/results/v163-phase-unit-failure-v1.json';assert not failure.exists()
source=repo/'.cache/test-late-harmonic-phase-before-conjugacy-tolerance-v1.py';log=repo/'.cache/v163-phase-unit-check-v2.log'
save(failure,{'status':'preserved-test-assertion-failure','test_source':dict(ref(source),text=source.read_text()),
    'log':dict(ref(log),text=log.read_text()),'reason':'Exact conjugacy assertion on an FP64 FFT fixture;maximum absolute discrepancy1.3877787807814457e-16. Only assertion tolerance corrected;model unchanged.',
    'corrected_regression_log':dict(ref(repo/'.cache/v163-CPU-regression-v1.log'),text=(repo/'.cache/v163-CPU-regression-v1.log').read_text()),
    'scope':'CPU test invocations separate from scientific study counters. No scientific controller restart.'})
dest=repo/'docs/results/v163-harmonic-phase-preparation-v1';dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
names={'plan.json':'plan-v1.json','quality-design.json':'quality-design-v1.json','CPU-readiness.json':'CPU-readiness-v1.json',
    'parity.json':'parity-result-v1.json','smoke.json':'smoke-result-v1.json','readiness-audit.json':'readiness-audit-v1.json',
    'training-prefix.jsonl':snapshot.name,'live-snapshot.json':live_snapshot.name,
    'postprocess-imports.json':'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json','postprocess-plan.json':'postprocess-plan-v1.json',
    'retained-native-comparators.json':'native-retained-comparators-v1.json'}
copies={}
originals={name:root/source for name,source in names.items()}
originals.update({name:repo/'docs/results'/source for name,source in {
    'research.json':'harmonic-phase-research-20261107-v1.json','phase-witness.json':'v163-phase-information-witness-v2.json',
    'phase-witness-failure.json':'v163-phase-information-witness-failure-v1.json','unit-failure.json':failure.name}.items()})
for name,p in originals.items():
    q=dest/name;shutil.copyfile(p,q);assert p.read_bytes()==q.read_bytes();copies[name]={'original':ref(p),'public':ref(q)}
paths=list((Path(plan['work'])/'scripts').glob('*.py'))+list((Path(plan['work'])/'configs').glob('*'))
paths+=list((root/'postprocess-v1/scripts').glob('*.py'))
tests=read(root/'CPU-readiness-v1.json')['tests']['command'].split(' pytest ',1)[1].split(' -q')[0].split()
paths += [repo/p for p in tests]
paths += [repo/p for p in ['src/demosaic/late_harmonic_phase.py','scripts/train_harmonic_phase_trial.py',
    'scripts/review_harmonic_phase_trial.py','scripts/diagnose_harmonic_phase_trial.py','configs/quality-v143-harmonic-phase-v163.yaml',
    '.cache/build-v163-controller-v1.py','.cache/launch-v163-v1.py','.cache/prepare-v163-postprocess-v1.py',
    '.cache/queue-v163-review-v1.py','.cache/launch-v163-queue-v1.py','.cache/prove-v163-phase-information-v1.py',
    '.cache/prove-v163-phase-information-v2.py','.cache/test-late-harmonic-phase-before-conjugacy-tolerance-v1.py']]
paths=list(dict.fromkeys(paths))
previous=read(Path(plan['previous'])/'plan-v1.json')
neural={p:h for p,h in previous['frozen_files'].items() if Path(p).parent.name=='demosaic'};assert len(neural)==88
for p,h in neural.items():assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==ref(Path(plan['work'])/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
bundle=dest/'source-bundle-v1.json';save(bundle,{'source_texts':[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in paths],
    'unchanged_neural_hashes':neural,'publisher':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
index=repo/'docs/results/v163-harmonic-phase-preparation-v1.json';assert not index.exists()
save(index,{'status':'ready-original-training-live-quality-pending','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'copies':copies,
    'sources':ref(bundle),'source_texts':len(paths),'unchanged_neural_sources':88,'new_neural_modules':1,
    'parameters':{'anchor-control':124397,'harmonic-phase':124909},'parameter_tensors':{'anchor-control':46,'harmonic-phase':47},
    'flat_anchor_weight_both':.25,'new_phase_coordinates':16,'new_phase_parameters':512,
    'actual_CPU_tests':180,'new_phase_checks':24,'compatibility_contexts':28,'compatibility_head_calls':56,
    'additional_prefix_leaf_output_CUDA_backwards':10,'discarded_smoke_head_calls':20,
    'separate_CPU_frequency_gain_calls_including_failed_serializer':4,
    'finite_Adam_states_after_restored_smoke':93,'exact_V162_control_prefix_rows':40,
    'fixed_heads':2,'fixed_endpoints':4,'steps_per_head':1000,'review_cases':822,'planned_review_calls':3288,
    'planned_phase_removal_calls':48,'planned_total_scientific_head_calls_excluding_tests':5412,'planned_head_image_evaluations':11472,
    'planned_new_prediction_arrays':1668,'planned_native_images':72,'planned_triplets':24,'retained_native_columns':7,
    'planned_native_RGB_channels':58137600,'quality_complete':False,'performance_native_viewing_complete':False,
    'new_parent_DINO_source_noise_calls':0,'original_lookups':0,'RAW_decodes':0,'scope':plan['scope']})
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print('Published',len(copies),'exact readiness receipts,',len(paths),'source texts,88 unchanged neural hashes,40 exact control/mask rows;3 actual owners live')
